senses.gloss: Ilā, the daughter of Manu Vaivasvata and the mother of Purūravas.--§ 139 (Manu Vaivasvata): I, 75, 3141 (the eighth child of Manu Vaivasvata).--§ 140 (Purūravas): I, 75, 3143 (at one time the father and the mother of Purūravas).--§ 156 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 95, 3760 (daughter of Manu and mother of Purūravas).--§ 748b (Tārakavadhop.): XIII, 86, 4209 (presented Skanda with a great many of flowers and fruits).-§ 768b (Kṛshṇa Vāsudeva): XIII, 147, 6831 (Manoś ca vaṃśaja Ilā Sudyumnaś ca bhavishyati, wife of Budha and mother of Purūravas). Cf. Sudyumna.
Ilāspada, a tirtha. § 364 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 83, 6047 (cf. BR., s.v. iḍ).
Ilāvṛta, name of a varsha. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 6, 233 (in the middle of Jambudvīpa).
